benefits.name: TSA PreCheck / Global Entry Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit up to $120 for a Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee.

benefits.name: TrueBlue Travel Statement Credit
benefits.description: Up to $300 in annual statement credits for hotel, car rental, and cruise bookings made through TrueBlue Travel.
benefits.terms: Covers hotels, car rentals, and cruises booked via TrueBlue Travel. Added as part of the spring 2026 benefits refresh.

benefits.name: Annual Companion Pass Credits
benefits.description: Statement credit of up to $500 toward a companion's ticket after $15,000 in calendar-year spend, plus an additional credit of up to $1,500 after $75,000 in calendar-year spend.
benefits.terms: Statement credit issued after both the cardholder and companion travel. Requires $15,000 calendar-year spend for the first credit (up to $500) and $75,000 calendar-year spend for the second (up to $1,500). Added as part of the spring 2026 benefits refresh.

benefits.name: Card Anniversary Bonus Points
benefits.description: 5,000 bonus TrueBlue points every year after the account anniversary.

benefits.name: Free First Checked Bag
benefits.description: First checked bag free for the cardholder and up to 3 companions on the same JetBlue-operated reservation, when the ticket is purchased with the card.
benefits.terms: Ticket must be purchased with the JetBlue Premier Card. Covers cardholder plus up to 3 travel companions on the same reservation.

benefits.name: 15% Points Back on Award Travel
benefits.description: Get 15% of redeemed points back after booking and flying a JetBlue-operated award flight.
benefits.terms: Increased from 10% (JetBlue Plus Card rate) as part of the spring 2026 benefits refresh.

benefits.name: Priority Pass Select & JetBlue Lounge Access
benefits.description: Complimentary membership to Priority Pass Select, granting access to 1,800+ airport lounges, plus access to JetBlue's own BlueHouse lounges at JFK Terminal 5 (with Boston opening summer 2026).
benefits.terms: JetBlue BlueHouse currently at JFK Terminal 5; Boston location opening summer 2026.

benefits.name: JetBlue Mosaic Status Tile Earning
benefits.description: Earn 1 Tile toward JetBlue Mosaic elite status for every $1,000 spent on the card, plus a 25-Tile bonus each year (roughly halfway to Mosaic 1).
benefits.terms: The 25-Tile annual bonus was added as part of the spring 2026 benefits refresh. Tiles count toward Mosaic status thresholds; does not by itself grant Mosaic status.

benefits.name: Group A Boarding
benefits.description: Complimentary Group A boarding on JetBlue-operated flights.

earningRates.terms: Eligible JetBlue and TrueBlue Travel purchases.
